paper_title: Search for ultralight scalar dark matter with atomic spectroscopy
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (dilaton-like photon coupling normalized to gravitational strength, kappa = sqrt(4 pi G_N))
notes: Van Tilburg, Leefer, Bougas, Budker (arXiv:1503.06886): first atomic-spectroscopy limit on ultralight scalar DM coupling d_e to photons via oscillations in alpha, using rf transitions in 162Dy/164Dy. Explicit anchors from text: best limit |d_e| ~ 4.2e-8 at m_phi ~ 1e-22 eV; limits surpass EP tests (|d_e| < 3.6e-4) for m_phi < 3e-18 eV; sensitivity extends to m_phi < ~1e-15 eV (omega < 1 rad/s). Assumes phi = all of DM with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3.
